description:
Builds a v2 sales_tax_payment_check.create request.

The `sales_tax_payment_check_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

address.description: If an address request fails, some combination of address fields might be too long. In a Check, BillPaymentCheck, or SalesTaxPaymentCheck message, Address is the address that will print on the check.

addr1.description: The first line of an address.

addr2.description: The second line of an address (if a second line is needed).

addr3.description: The third line of an address (if a third line is needed).

addr4.description: The fourth line of an address (if a fourth line is needed).

addr5.description: The fifth line of an address (if a fifth line is needed).

city.description: The city name in an address.

country.description: The country name in an address, or, in returned Host information (HostRet or HostInfo), the country for which this edition of QuickBooks was designed. (Possible values are US, CA, UK, and AU.)

note.description: In a BillAddress or ShipAddress aggregate, the Note field value is written at the bottom of the address in the form in which it appears, such as the invoice form.

postal_code.description: The postal code in an address.

state.description: The state name in an address.

bank_account_ref.description: Refers to the account from which the funds are being drawn for this check, for example, Checking or Savings.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

def_macro.description: `def_macro` lets you assign a reusable name to a returned `txn_id` or `txn_line_id` so later requests can reference it with `useMacro`. This feature requires SDK 2.0+.

external_guid.description: Allows for the attachment of a user defined GUID value.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

is_to_be_printed.description:
If `is_to_be_printed` is true, QuickBooks queues the form for later printing. It does not print immediately; printing is still a user action in QuickBooks.

Choose exactly one of: `is_to_be_printed`, or `ref_number`.

payee_entity_ref.description: `payee_entity_ref` identifies the payee (customer, vendor, employee, or Other Name). If both `full_name` and `list_id` are provided, `full_name` is ignored.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

ref_number.description:
`ref_number` is a user-managed transaction reference (for example, a check number). It can be edited and is not guaranteed to be globally unique.

Choose exactly one of: `is_to_be_printed`, or `ref_number`.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

item_sales_tax_ref.description: An ItemSalesTax entry represents one tax rate paid to one tax agency. Use it when a transaction needs a single tax calculation. For multi-rate scenarios, use a sales-tax group instead.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

txn_date.description: The date of the transaction. In some cases, if you leave `txn_date` out of an -Add message, QuickBooks will prefill `txn_date` with the date of the last-saved transaction of the same type.
